items.q: I'm not sure he was ever with us in the, in the jazz band. But uh, yeah, uh, Leo was a great musician

ctx.x: Yeah, yeah. Those were my duties. But some time we did, first we did a few variety shows which included the son of Bing Crosby, a guy named Gary Crosby, for inst… as an example. Uh, and uh, various and sundry musicians who had applied to this Special Service Unit. And uh, that's where uh, uh, my, uh, musical uh, activities began. That's when my musical activities began in the, in the military, playin' for these shows and then finally a jazz, a real jazz band. They called it Jazz One 'cause later on, they had Jazz…

Oh yeah. He, he was uh, he was part of the, he was in the, he was in the uh, the uh, the Colonel's favorite – the, the symphony, you know. So he played the jazz saxophone uh, when necessary in the symphony orchestra. So uh, when they had pieces that required that instrument, I recall.
